dogecoin.text:
@curtiskitchen This is your area, so I'll defer. My sense of Dogecoin was that ALL it is was a "brand." Basically all sizzle, no steak. Like, the story is fun, but the coin literally has ZERO practical value, and no one working to GIVE it a practical value.

Am I misunderstanding "brand"?
@curtiskitchen @klever_io There is absolutely no justification for the price of Dogecoin. And that's coming from me, who made a couple hundred dollars off of Dogecoin. It makes no sense at all

Don't put any money in Dogecoin you can't afford to lose. There was never any logical reason for the huge run. I mean, I love the story, but it's literally a meme coin. It has no actual transactional value. It is only a trading vehicle and nothing more.
